intro: People you share this document with can read it, but never change it. A share works only while you can open the document yourself.
intro_calendar: People you share this calendar with can see when this person is off — dates and paid/unpaid only, never the kind of leave, the budget or the reasons — but never change anything. A share works only while you can see the calendar yourself.
intro_pulse: People you share this team's pulse results with see exactly what you see — the team's aggregated scores, the trend and, if you can read them, the anonymized comments. Never who answered what, and never anything you can't see yourself. A share works only while you can see the team's results yourself. People you share with can tell which survey cycles you took part in.
untilHint: Optional. Access ends at the end of this day (server time); leave it empty for no end date.
withdrawBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to open this document through this share. This cannot be undone.
withdrawBody_calendar: {{name}} will no longer be able to see this calendar through this share. This cannot be undone.
withdrawBody_pulse: {{name}} will no longer be able to see these pulse results through this share. This cannot be undone.
lapsed: The person who shared this document with you can no longer open it, so your access has ended.
